items.text: Christine stared at the bread mixture in the bowl. <break time="0.8s" /> Ugh, This is not working, Christine shouted. <break time="0.8s" /> She wanted to bake some bread, but the mixture would not rise. <break time="0.8s" /> She checked the recipe again but did not know what went wrong. <break time="0.8s" /> Christine sighed loudly and pushed the bowl away. <break time="0.8s" /> Why will this not work, she said with a frown. <break time="0.8s" /> Seeing her struggle, Christines father offered some advice. <break time="0.8s" /> Try adding a little more baking powder, he suggested. <break time="0.8s" /> Christine followed his advice and added another spoonful. <break time="0.8s" /> After only a few minutes, the mixture began to rise. <break time="0.8s" /> Christines eyes widened, and her heart began pounding. <break time="0.8s" /> It finally works, she exclaimed. <break time="0.8s" /> Christine eagerly poured the mixture into a pan and placed it in the oven. <break time="0.8s" /> This bread will be delicious.
